confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Amman, not from live menus, listings, or booking pages, and no July-specific rates were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately reliable; hotel tiers vary widely by neighborhood and season. Alcohol anchors are least certain because venue type, licensing, and taxes drive large swings. Cocktail (about 2.3x beer) and wine glass (about 1.8x beer) are derived from the beer anchor because direct knowledge of Amman bar prices is weak. Prices assume the amount typically paid, including customary taxes or service. The FX value is the 14 Oct 2026 RBA 4pm observation as shown in search results for the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Regional basis only: Amman priced against general Levant and Middle East urban levels for mid-range restaurants, hostels, and hotels, from general knowledge.
